think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric parameter with an inherent ordering. 3) If numeric, check for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just ‘more/less’. 4) If the knob is not numeric (e.g., enum/string), it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition; classify as not special under this criterion.
